timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: clear_render_queue
title: Clear render queue
description: Remove render queue items (all, or only finished ones).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: render_queue
title: Render queue
description: The render queue in one tool: action render (default: renders the queue, blocking AE until done) | list | clear | add (same arguments as add_to_render_queue). Prefer render_in_background for long renders.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: render_in_background
title: Render in background (aerender)
description: Render a comp with aerender in a separate process (project is saved first). wait:true waits with per-frame progress. Details: ae://docs/render_in_background

comp.description: Composition name.

name: get_background_render
title: Background render status
description: Status, progress and log tail of background renders.

name: replace_footage
title: Replace footage
description: Swap the source file of a footage item (or a still/image sequence) for another file. Every comp that uses it keeps its layers, timing and effects.

sequence.description: Replace with an image sequence starting at file.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: list_presets
title: List animation presets
description: List .ffx animation presets from the user's User Presets folder and the After Effects Presets folder, with name filter. Use the path with apply_preset_file.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: get_properties_at_time
title: Read properties at a time
description: Read many properties of many layers at one time in one call: requests [{layer, properties:[...]}]. Details: ae://docs/get_properties_at_time

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: list_essential_properties
title: List Essential Properties
description: Without layer: list the Essential Graphics controllers of a comp. With layer (a precomp layer in comp): list that instance's Essential Properties with their current values.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: set_essential_property
title: Set Essential Property
description: Set an Essential Property value on one precomp layer instance (by name or 1-based index), e.g. change the title text or color of one use of a template comp.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

value.description: Value: number, array ([x,y] / [x,y,z]), color, string (Source Text) or object (shape path / text style).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: set_essential_properties
title: Set Essential Properties
description: Set several Essential Properties of one precomp instance by name in one call: values {"Texto": "Ao vivo", "Cor": "#ff3366"}.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: instantiate_template
title: Instantiate template
description: Place a template comp N times into another comp, each with its own name, position and Essential Property values: items [{name, position, values}].

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: export_mogrt
title: Export .mogrt
description: Export a comp with Essential Graphics controllers as a Motion Graphics Template (.mogrt). path: a folder, or a full .mogrt file path (its name becomes the template name).

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

name: add_to_essential_graphics
title: Add to Essential Graphics
description: Expose a property of a layer in its comp's Essential Graphics panel (optionally with a custom name) so precomp instances can override it.

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

layer.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

templateName.description: Name of the Motion Graphics template (instead of 'Untitled').

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: list_fonts
title: List fonts
description: Search installed fonts; returns PostScript names to use in text tools (AE 2024+).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: get_selection
title: Get selection
description: What the user has selected in AE right now: active comp, playhead, selected layers and properties. Great for 'animate this layer' requests.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: select_layers
title: Select layers
description: Select layers in the timeline (empty list clears the selection).

comp.description: Composition name or numeric item id. Omit to use the active composition.

items.description: Layer: 1-based index, exact name, or 'id:<layerId>' (stable across reordering).

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: begin_undo_group
title: Begin undo group
description: Group the following calls so ONE undo call reverts them all. Close with end_undo_group. Details: ae://docs/begin_undo_group

name: end_undo_group
title: End undo group
description: Close the open undo group. The next undo call without steps reverts every call of the group.

name: undo
title: Undo / redo
description: Undo or redo the last After Effects steps. Every MCP call is a single undo step; right after end_undo_group, undo without steps reverts the whole group.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: execute_menu_command
title: Run menu command
description: Execute an AE menu command by id or (English) menu name, e.g. 'Fit to Comp', 'Center Anchor Point in Layer Content'.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: run_extendscript
title: Run ExtendScript
description: Run custom ExtendScript (ES3 function body; `return` a value). AEMCP helpers and `args` are available. Disabled with AE_MCP_EVAL=off. Details: ae://docs/run_extendscript

parkViewer.description: Show a tiny empty comp in the viewer while this runs (much faster for heavy changes to an open comp); the viewer is restored afterwards, also on error.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).

name: batch
title: Batch operations
description: Run many AE tools in ONE call and ONE undo step, e.g. [{tool:'create_text_layer',args:{...}},{tool:'animate_layer',args:{...}}]. Fails with isError + partial results; atomic:true reverts all. Details: ae://docs/batch

atomic.description: Revert every operation if any fails.

verbose.description: Full result of every operation. Default false: each entry is {index, tool, ok, id, name} (plus error/warning).

parkViewer.description: Default true: hide the comp from the viewer while a 20+ operation batch runs.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for After Effects (default 60, long tools 300+).
